summary: Add opt-in report-to: a mission run tells a named agent when it fails, is cancelled or stalls

replay.detail: No history is folded or rebuilt. A run's reporting is read from its own creation claim while the run is evaluated, so existing runs, which carry no report fields, are never reported.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes or triggers change. The mission-run.created claim gains optional report_to, stalled_after_ms and report_completed fields, written only when a mission or a start names a reporter.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged. A run with no reporter writes a creation claim identical to before, so its claim identity is unchanged.

compatibility.detail: A mission gains the report-to, stalled-after and report-completed properties, and missions start gains --report-to and --report-completed. A mission-run.created claim that carries the new fields is registered in this build's claim schema; a member on an older build may not accept the field, so upgrade every member of a fleet before using report-to. Runs that name no reporter are unaffected. Not tested against an older build.

downtime.detail: No restart-specific work. The first reconcile pass after a restart evaluates each run once, as it already does.

manual.detail: Opt-in only. Add report-to="agent/NAME" to a mission or pass --report-to AGENT to st missions start; the guide is in docs/st3/mission-graph-runtime.md under Run reports.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary at any time. Messages already sent stay in the reporter's mailbox; a run that carried report fields is then simply not reported.
